# openGym vendored UI chrome

These files are adapted from [openGym](https://github.com/DuarteSantos8/openGym)
by Duarte Santos, licensed **GNU AGPL v3.0**.

Fitness OS imports `index.css` as the phone-width visual system (tokens, cards,
grouped lists, tab bar, workout logger, rest timer, sheets). Product features
(Eat, Pulse coach, Supabase) remain Fitness OS code under the same AGPL license.

See `/NOTICE.md` and `/LICENSE`.
